text_block_list.text:
While talking with Super Creek
about training—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, I'm sorry.
Did I startle you?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you're very kind, Trainer-san.
I'll be just fine.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It's just a slight headache...
I'm sure it'll go away soon, though.
Though she says that, she looks like she's having a rough time. I should probably keep an eye on her.
